subject: CS480
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. Coverage for Arabic was challenging, with two topics ('A Systems View of Project Management' and 'The Four Frames of Organizations') having no sufficiently relevant candidates. For the selected videos, choices were guided by a balance of high relevance and strong viewership, ensuring both accuracy and peer-validated quality.
